tools.name: calculate_typing_score
tools.description: Use this when a typing test has finished, or when the user gives the target passage, what they typed, and the time taken and wants their typing speed. Compares word by word and computes exact WPM = (correct characters / 5) / minutes, raw WPM (all typed characters), accuracy = correct / (correct + er

tools.name: show_typing_test
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to take a typing test, check their typing speed (WPM), practice typing, test on their own paragraph, or drill weak keys. Opens a live test in the widget: the timer starts on the first keystroke, characters are highlighted as typed, and the widget scores the result with c
